Discover APIs with apis.api_docs.show_api_descriptions(app_name=...) and inspect signatures with apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name=..., api_name=...) before calling them. Do not invent API names or arguments. Read each tool observation, and correct the cause when execution fails instead of repeating the same code. Variables persist between executions. Tool observations appear in <tool_response> tags. Use the supervisor completion API only after you have finished the requested task.
